invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of collectAsList(), which is non-null barring exceptions.
The result list should have the same size as the input list dedupedRecords, as tagLocation is expected to tag each record but not change cardinality.
The method accesses table.getIndex(), which would throw a NullPointerException if it were null.
table is dereferenced; it must not be null at the method exit.
context is passed as an argument to tagLocation and must not be null when called.
